title: ALMA-IRDC - II. First high-angular resolution measurements of the <SUP>14</SUP>N/<SUP>15</SUP>N ratio in a large sample of infrared-dark cloud cores
question: What is the $^{14}$N/$^{15}$N ratio in N$_{2}$H$^{+}$ at high angular resolution across dense cores in infrared-dark clouds, and how does it relate to surrounding diffuse gas and core physical or evolutionary properties?

what.value: 3 mm continuum core identification, angular diameters, starless/star-forming classification, and physical properties (R_eff, M, T_dust, M_S, alpha_vir, n(H2), N(H2))

evidence.quote: The parameter set and method for determination of the continuum dendrogram structure is described in Paper I.

In Figs. 6 and 7, we compare the $^{14}$N/$^{15}$N ratios in the 17 continuum cores detected in N$^{15}$NH$^+$ with some physical properties that were derived in paper I, namely: radius ($R_{\rm eff}$), gas mass ($M$), dust temperature ($T_{\rm dust}$, used to compute $M$), sonic Mach number ($\mathcal{M}_{\rm S}$), virial parameter ($\alpha_{\rm vir}$), H$_2$ volume density ($n{\rm (H_2)}$), and H$_2$ column density ($N{\rm (H_2)}$).

external_data.citation: Barnes et al. in prep. (paper I)

recipe.goal: Calibrate, continuum-subtract, image, and feather the ALMA 12m, 7m, and Total Power cubes
recipe.method: Calibrate and image interferometric and single-dish data with the CASA pipeline, subtract continuum in the (u,v)-domain using line-free channels, and combine 12m, 7m, and total power cubes using CASA feather
key_parameters: feather default parameter set (effective dish size, single-dish scaling, low-pass filtering)

recipe.goal: Identify 3 mm continuum cores and N2H+ intensity peak cores using 2D dendrograms
recipe.method: Apply 2D dendrogram analysis to 3 mm continuum maps (from Paper I) and to 2D integrated intensity maps of N2H+ (1-0)
key_parameters: For N2H+ dendrogram: min_value = 30 sigma ~ 4.5 K km/s, min_delta = 30 sigma, min_pix = 3 beam ~ 150 pixels

recipe.goal: Extract spectra from core contours and convert flux density to brightness temperature
recipe.method: Convert clean cubes to FITS format, extract spectra over continuum core contours, N2H+ core contours, and total power beam positions using GILDAS MAPPING, smooth to ~0.4 km/s resolution, and convert integrated flux density F_nu to brightness temperature T_B using Eq. 1
key_parameters: Spectral smoothing to ~0.4 km s^-1; Total power HPBW ~ 70"
assumptions: Eq. 1 is valid for non-spherical sources using equivalent circle angular diameter Theta

recipe.goal: Fit N15NH+ (1-0) and N2H+ (1-0) spectral lines and integrate hyperfine components
recipe.method: Fit N15NH+ (1-0) with a single Gaussian to the main F=2-1 component (or simultaneous hyperfine fit using CLASS method hfs in D5c5/6/7, F1c3, F4c5, F4c7); evaluate N2H+ (1-0) isolated F1=0-1 component by comparing peak velocities with N15NH+ to distinguish multiple velocity components from self-absorption, and integrate either the strongest velocity feature or the whole F1=0-1 component
key_parameters: Relative strength of N2H+ F1=0-1 component is 1/9 of total (multiply by 9); relative strength of N15NH+ F=2-1 component is 0.555 (divide by 0.555)
assumptions: Velocity separation of hyperfine components fixed to laboratory values; all components have the same T_ex and FWHM

recipe.goal: Derive total column densities N_tot(N2H+) and N_tot(N15NH+) and 14N/15N ratios
recipe.method: Calculate total column densities from total integrated intensities using Eq. (A4) of Caselli et al. (2002) at T_ex = 10 K and 50 K, compute 3-sigma upper limits using Eq. 2 for non-detections, and take the ratio N_tot(N2H+)/N_tot(N15NH+)
key_parameters: T_ex = 10 K and 50 K; 3 sigma threshold for upper limits with mean cloud FWHM
assumptions: Optically thin emission and identical, constant excitation temperature T_ex (10 K to 50 K) for N2H+ and N15NH+ and all hyperfine components

recipe.goal: Compare 14N/15N ratios with star-formation activity and core physical properties
recipe.method: Compare mean 14N/15N between starless and star-forming cores and perform non-parametric statistical tests and Pearson's r correlation analysis between 14N/15N and core physical parameters (R_eff, M, T_dust, M_S, alpha_vir, n(H2), N(H2))
assumptions: Adopted non-background-subtracted core masses and volume densities; Herschel maps resampled to ALMA resolution via bilinear interpolation

However, critical observational and imaging parameters and the exact 3 mm continuum core definitions/apertures (Theta and contours) are deferred to an unpublished companion paper (Barnes et al. in prep.).
rediscovery_reason: Raw and pipeline-reduced ALMA data for 2017.1.00687.S and 2018.1.00850.S are public in the ALMA archive, the spectral line analysis recipe (feathering, dendrogram extraction, F1=0-1 and F=2-1 integration, LTE column density ratios) is clearly specified, and the main results are numeric tables of integrated intensities, column densities, and 14N/15N ratios.
